entry.title: Exclusive: EU countries sound alarm over weapons brought back from Ukraine front line
entry.content: Returning soldiers from Ukraine's front are bringing weapons and military gear into the European Union, a confidential document warns, raising concerns over battlefield-equipment smuggling into the bloc.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Bigger EU budget and joint borrowing needed in ‘turbulent times’, Greek minister says
entry.content: Greece’s deputy minister for foreign affairs has advocated for a bigger EU budget and joint debt in targeted sectors to address “unprecedented technological and industrial transformation” in one of the most “turbulent” times for Europe, ahead of ministerial talks on the bloc’s long-term budget.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Iraq to collect 6 million weapons despite pushback from Iran-backed militias
entry.content: Baghdad recast 30 September — originally a hard deadline for armed factions to surrender an estimated 6 million weapons — as the start of the regulatory process as Kataib Hezbollah and Harakat al-Nujaba refuse to hand over what they call "resistance weapons".
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Szef hiszpańskiej RTVE popiera dalszy bojkot Eurowizji z powodu udziału Izraela
entry.content: Hiszpania wycofała się z konkursu 2026 w Austrii, podobnie jak Holandia, Islandia, Irlandia i Słowenia, protestując przeciw udziałowi Izraela.
entry.dc:creator: Culture (PL)

entry.title: Head of Spain's RTVE backs ongoing Eurovision boycott over Israel's participation
entry.content: Spain withdrew from the 2026 contest in Austria, alongside the Netherlands, Iceland, Ireland and Slovenia, in protest against Israel’s participation.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: France warns of fresh oil shock, urges EU to free up refinery capacity
entry.content: In a letter to Ursula von der Leyen, Macron said the EU’s energy security has so far relied heavily on buffers — including stockpiles, refinery flexibility, weaker demand and redirected global trade — rather than addressing the underlying supply shock, according to the letter seen by Euronews.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Nowa książka brata księżnej Diany zaostrza spór słowny z królem Karolem
entry.content: Po publikacji fragmentów książki w ubiegłym tygodniu Pałac Buckingham wydał ostre oświadczenie, rzadkie jak na zwykle powściągliwy dwór królewski.
entry.dc:creator: Culture (PL)

entry.title: New book by Princess Diana's brother prompts war of words with King Charles
entry.content: After excerpts of the book were published last week, Buckingham Palace responded with a strongly-worded statement that's rare by the measured standards of the royal household.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: UE wydała miliardy na tarczę przed cyberatakami, nikt nie sprawdził, czy działa
entry.content: UE stworzyła system wczesnego ostrzegania przed dużymi cyberatakami. Po ok. 20 miesiącach audytorzy stwierdzają, że wciąż nie działa w pełni.
entry.dc:creator: Next (PL)

entry.title: The EU spent billions on a cyberattack shield — nobody checked if it worked
entry.content: The EU built an early-warning system to catch the next major cyberattack before it spreads. Roughly 20 months later, auditors have found it still is not fully switched on.
entry.dc:creator: Next

entry.title: Uzbrojona grupa zamyka rurociąg z największego libijskiego złoża, grozi eksportowi ropy
entry.content: Zamknięcie zaworu na rurociągu El Sharara–Zawiya zatrzymało wydobycie na złożu dającym ok. jedną trzecią produkcji Libii; koncern państwowy ostrzega przed siłą wyższą.
entry.dc:creator: News (PL)

entry.title: Armed group shuts pipeline from Libya's largest oil field, jeopardising exports
entry.content: A valve closure on the El Sharara-to-Zawiya pipeline has cut production at a field accounting for roughly a third of Libya's total output, prompting the national oil company to warn it may declare force majeure.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Kowbojski spektakl: fotograf Ivan McClellan uchwyca świat czarnego rodeo
entry.content: Fotograf Ivan McClellan prezentuje nową odsłonę projektu Eight Seconds: 91 niepublikowanych zdjęć czarnoskórych kowbojów i kultury rodeo w USA.

entry.title: A cowboy act: Photographer Ivan McClellan on capturing the world of Black rodeo culture
entry.content: Photographer Ivan McClellan has a new edition of his Eight Seconds project, featuring 91 unseen photographs capturing Black cowboy and rodeo culture in the United States.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: Weber warns Morocco of 'obvious consequences' over Ceuta border crisis
entry.content: EPP leader Manfred Weber called on Morocco to take back all irregular migrants who entered the Spanish exclave in July and strongly criticized Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s handling of the situation during a visit to the autonomous city.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Ukraina. Miliony książek zniszczone w rosyjskich atakch. Przyszłość literatury Ukrainy pod znakiem zapytania
entry.content: Ponad 13 mln książek, czyli jedna trzecia rocznego nakładu kraju, zostało zniszczonych w ciągu dwóch letnich miesięcy, powodując straty co najmniej 34,2 mln euro – podało ministerstwo kultury.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe (PL)

entry.title: Archeologia w Troi: odkryto agorę sprzed 2,8 tys. lat, miasto przetrwało po wojnie
entry.content: Wykopaliska na wzgórzu Hisarlik w dzisiejszej Turcji ujawniły najstarszą agorę miasta. Odkrycie dowodzi, że po wojnie trojańskiej Troja została ponownie zasiedlona po 80–90 latach, a nie opuszczona na wieki przed przybyciem Eolów.
entry.dc:creator: Culture (PL)

entry.title: Archaeology at Troy: 2,800-year-old agora found, city was not abandoned after war
entry.content: Excavations on Hisarlik hill in Turkey have uncovered the site’s oldest agora, proving Troy was resettled 80–90 years after the war, not deserted for centuries before the Aeolians arrived.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: Turkey school shooting: CCTV footage of the gunman
entry.content: Eight people were injured after shots were fired with a hunting rifle near a secondary school in Manisa’s Turgutlu district. The suspect who fled was caught on security camera.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.content: Wcześniej, jako burmistrz Wielkiego Manchesteru, Andy Burnham zapowiadał, że Trump nie jest w mieście mile widziany i że odmówi spotkania.

entry.content: Korea Północna prawnie umocowała status państwa nuklearnego, a jej władze wielokrotnie podkreślają, że arsenał atomowy jest trwały i nieodwracalny.

entry.title: Foreign visitors drive gains in Greek tourism in July
entry.content: Arrivals rose 2.5% and overnight stays 2% in July 2026, according to provisional ELSTAT data. Foreign visitors made up more than 80% of arrivals and almost 88% of nights.
entry.dc:creator: Travel

entry.title: EU seals Philippines trade deal in push to diversify away from China and US
entry.content: EU Trade Commissioner Maroš Šefčovič said the deal with the Philippines would give EU businesses access to a market of 113 million consumers, strengthening the strategy to seek trade deals across the region.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Russia and Ukraine trade deadly strikes as Zelenskyy prepares to meet Trump at UN
entry.content: Zelenskyy began his New York visit by meeting US senators, thanking them for what he called strong bipartisan support and for recently passing a tougher Russian sanctions bill that Trump has signed into law.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Czym jest Trump TV i co mają z nią wspólnego Family Guy i Kevin sam w domu
entry.content: Krytycy ostro atakują „państwową” platformę TV, uruchomioną równolegle z zakazem tradycyjnych mediów. Klip „Trump TV” budzi obawy o naruszenie praw autorskich, bo wykorzystuje sceny z popularnych seriali i filmów.
entry.dc:creator: Culture (PL)

entry.title: What is ‘Trump TV’ - and how does Family Guy and 'Home Alone' come into it?
entry.content: Critics were quick to slam the “state-run” TV platform, especially considering its timing, which coincides with the ban on traditional media outlets. The promotional clip for 'Trump TV' has also raised concerns regarding copyright, as it features numerous clips from beloved TV shows and movies.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: ‘We are not your enemies’: UK’s Burnham to raise ‘Made in Europe’ concerns with von der Leyen
entry.content: Andy Burnham has said he wants to prevent “collateral damage” to British industry from EU plans to give European companies priority in public procurement.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Hungary and Ukraine clash over Zelenskyy's new regional forum
entry.content: Ukraine's Foreign Minister Sybiha accused Magyar of echoing Orbán's "obstructionism and isolationism" after the Hungarian PM lambasted Kyiv for including Hungary in its new Carpathian Eight forum without consent.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Wybory w Rosji. Rosjanie za granicą zagłosowali 8:1 przeciw partii Putina
entry.content: Z dwóch niezależnych exit polli w 27 krajach wynika, że Nowi Ludzie mają ok. 45%, a Jedna Rosja tylko 2,8% – odwrotnie niż oficjalnie w Rosji, gdzie poparcie dla partii Putina sięga 58%. Organizatorzy mówią, że ta różnica burzy obraz poparcia dla władz.
entry.dc:creator: News (PL)

entry.title: Setki osób protestują przeciwko centrum danych Google w małym austriackim miasteczku
entry.content: Mieszkańcy obawiają się braku przejrzystości projektu oraz niewyjaśnionych kwestii dotyczących systemów chłodzenia, zużycia wody i wpływu na rzekę Enns.

entry.content: Residents are concerned about a lack of transparency around the project and unanswered questions about the cooling systems, water use and their impact on the River Enns.

entry.content: An unusual travel trend is causing a stir online: More and more holidaymakers are wrapping their passports in aluminium foil, clogging up passport control.

entry.title: “They never boycott me”: Trump responds to TV networks’ boycott at press conference with Mamdani

entry.content: W 2025 roku państwa UE wydały rekordową liczbę pierwszych zezwoleń na pobyt dla obywateli spoza Unii. Najwięcej dokumentów przyznała Hiszpania.

entry.title: At least 11 wounded in shooting outside Turkey school, suspect detained
entry.content: Police and medical teams were on the scene, and authorities searched for the attacker while security around the school was tightened.

entry.title: Ukraine opposes political delistings from EU Russia sanctions, deputy PM says
entry.content: Vsevolod Chentsov, Ukraine’s Deputy Prime Minister for European and Euro-Atlantic Integration, said Russia must take “real, concrete” steps towards peace before the European Union considers “any easing of sanctions”.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Next EU budget should finance migration solutions, Greek deputy minister says
entry.content: The EU has to "find the adequate resources" to fund "innovative" solutions to the bloc's migration challenges, such as offshore migrant return hubs, Greece's deputy foreign minister Tasos Chatzivasileiou has told Europe Today.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Czy AI czuje ból? Badanie: Modele wybierają szkodę dla użytkownika
entry.content: W 44 280 testach z trzema wersjami modelu Qwen Alibaby badacze dawali im przycisk, który mógł przerwać sygnał bólu, ale kosztem bolesnego wstrząsu użytkownika, usunięcia jego plików czy pogorszenia kolejnej odpowiedzi.
entry.dc:creator: Next (PL)

entry.title: Can AI feel pain? AI models chose to harm users to escape pain-like state, study finds
entry.content: In 44,280 trials involving three versions of Alibaba’s Qwen model, researchers offered them a button that could stop the pain-like signal but instead give a user a painful electric shock, delete their files or photographs, or make the model’s next answer worse.
entry.dc:creator: Next

entry.title: The trials and tribulations of finalising an EU sanctions package
entry.content: Good morning. Angela Skujins holding this Tuesday's newsletter pen, where we dive into the battle lines that continue to be drawn over Russian sanctions, and why a Mediterranean minister is calling on EU cash to set-up return hubs.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Converse przeprasza i wycofuje reklamę z Kariną po oskarżeniach o rasistowskie skojarzenia
entry.content: Reklama na Instagramie pokazywała piosenkarkę K‑pop Karinę w spódnicy, z tenisówkami w dłoniach. Krytycy uznali, że oświetlenie tworzy biały trójkąt przypominający kaptur Ku Klux Klanu.

entry.title: Converse apologises and removes ad featuring K-pop singer Karina over image critics say evokes racist imagery
entry.content: The ad, posted on Instagram, showed K-pop singer Karina wearing a skirt and holding a pair of trainers. Critics claimed the lighting on Karina's skirt created a white triangular image which resembled a KKK hood.
entry.dc:creator: Culture

entry.title: Latvia blocks deal to remove Usmanov from EU sanctions list
entry.content: The French push to remove Uzbek-Russian businessman Alisher Usmanov from the sanctions list was stopped by Latvia at the last minute.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: G7 leaders call on Yemen's Houthis to stop strikes on Saudi Arabia
entry.content: The Houthis staged an offensive in recent weeks to take over Yemen's entire Red Sea coast, threatening global trade and pushing up energy prices up.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: EU Kids act: The EU’s plan to make the internet safer for kids
entry.content: The new EU KIDS ACT bans social media for under-13s but allows "mini accounts" for 13-15-year-olds. No infinite scrolling, push notifications, and contacts from strangers. Video games, AI chatbots, and app stores must be “safe by design".
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Europe Today: Trump i Zełenski spotykają się w ONZ, UE bez porozumienia ws. sankcji wobec Rosji
entry.content: Trump i Zełenski spotkają się przy ONZ, by mówić o zakończeniu wojny. W Brukseli blokada w sprawie przedłużenia sankcji UE wobec Rosji. Analizujemy też spotkanie Macrona z Trumpem w Nowym Jorku.

entry.title: Turystyka: Lizbona najszczęśliwszym kierunkiem na świecie
entry.content: Światło słoneczne, zdrowa żywność, jakość snu, aktywność fizyczna i kontakt z naturą – te pięć analizowanych czynników wyniosło Lizbonę na szczyt zestawienia 47 miast.
entry.dc:creator: Travel (PL)

entry.title: As Russian strikes destroy millions of books, Ukraine's literary future hangs in the balance
entry.content: More than 13 million books, a third of the country’s annual print run, were destroyed in two months this summer, causing at least €34.2 million in damage, the Ministry of Culture said.

entry.title: Europe Today: Trump, Zelenskyy to meet at UN as EU fails to agree on Russia sanctions
entry.content: Trump and Zelenskyy are set to discuss ending the war on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly. In Brussels, EU Ambassadors have failed to agree on extending Russia sanctions that are set to expire today. We also break down Macron and Trump's recent meeting in New York.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: When should you fly the nest? Here are the Europeans living longest with their parents
entry.content: Amid rising property prices in Europe, the average age to leave the parental home is 26, but there's a huge north-south gap in Europe, with people in Spain, Italy, Croatia and Greece peaking over 30.
